blocks.title: Toxicity (zehreelapan)
blocks.text: Toxicity woh had hai jis tak koi maddah kisi jandaar ya mahol ko nuqsan pohancha sakta hai.
Material apni tayyari, istemal aur aakhri disposal ke dauran zehreela ho sakta hai. Toxicity material se hone wale khatre (hazard) ki had aur qism se napi jati hai, aur khatre ki kai qismein hain.

items: Sehat ke khatre: maddah samna hone par sehat ko nuqsan deta hai. Maslan chromium ke compounds carcinogens (cancer paida karne wale) aur mutagens (DNA aur genes badalne wale) hain aur saans ki takleef dete hain; plastics mein kuch additives hormones ki kharabi la sakte hain.

Tabai khatre: tabai ya kimiyai khasiyaton ki wajah se imaraton, insanon, ecosystems aur mahol ko nuqsan; maslan aag pakarne wala ya dhamake wala material logon aur jangalon ko nuqsan ya imarat ko tabah kar sakta hai.

Mahol ke khatre: aabi zindagi ya mahol ko taveel muddat ka nuqsan. Lead, mercury aur cadmium jaisi heavy metals mitti aur zameeni pani mein reas (leach) sakti hain aur paudon, zameeni janwaron, machhliyon aur doosre aabi jandaron ke liye khatarnak hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khane: Health (chromium compounds), Physical (flammable, explosive) aur Environmental (mitti mein Pb, Hg, Cd).
blocks.caption: Khatron (hazards) ki teen qismein (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: Sehat ke khatre aur mahol ke khatre mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Sehat ka khatra samna hone par insan ki sehat ko nuqsan deta hai (maslan chromium se cancer); mahol ka khatra aabi zindagi ya mahol ko taveel nuqsan deta hai (maslan heavy metals ka mitti mein reasna).

items: Toxicity: maddah jandaron ya mahol ko kis had tak nuqsan de sakta.
